rule.statement: A presumption under Section 114(e) of the Evidence Ordinance that a letter has been sent to a disputed address cannot be drawn if the address on the registered post was not duly and properly filled.
rule.supporting_quote: In order for the courts to make a presumption under Section 114(e) of the Evidence Ordinance that the letter has been sent to the address in dispute, there should be evidence that the address has been correctly written on the registered post.
